english: Update the displayed local resource snapshot. This does not request network information.
Return to the screen that opened this snapshot, keeping its selection and draft.
Use Up/Down to select an item and Enter to activate it. Escape returns to the previous screen. Press ? on a selected control to read its help. Question marks remain text inside editors.

Servers lists every current server session. Up/Down chooses a server; Left/Right chooses an action; Enter activates that action. Open selects its channel 0, which shows server notices, /list results and connection replies. The server list and /list are different: /list requests channel names from the selected network.

The network channel directory is built from IRC LIST replies. Up/Down selects a channel; Left/Right selects Channel, Users or Topic sorting; S toggles ascending/descending; Enter joins; R refreshes; / opens the command prompt; Escape returns. /list options provide minimum/maximum users, name/topic filtering and a display limit.

Activity brings together retained mentions and unread source conversations across all servers. Up/Down selects an entry; Enter opens its source. Clear mentions removes copied mention records while preserving source histories and unread counters. Mentions can overlap unread messages, so their counts are separate.
Ignore limit is {limit} masks; remove one before adding another.
